say:2:1010013001:1.text:
Valen! You're just getting here now?
Were you deep in your cups again?
say:2:1010013001:1.source_cn: 维伦！磨磨蹭蹭，现在才来！\n你是不是又一头栽进酒馆里了？

say:3:1010013002:1.text: That's not fair... I ran into a bunch of fire elementals on the way here. Those guys were really annoying.
say:3:1010013002:1.source_cn: 冤枉……我在路上遇到了一大群火元素，那些小家伙实在太烦人了。

say:4:1010013003:1.text: Anyway, looks pretty grim here... I didn't expect the fire to be this big. This is not normal, General.
say:4:1010013003:1.source_cn: 话说回来，这景象真是惨烈啊……没想到火势这么凶猛。将军...

say:7:1010013004:1.text: That's right! We think it's <style="highlight">arson</style>. The culprit is likely a mage!

say:8:1010013005:1.text: Whoa... A talking hamster. You're a familiar, aren't you?
say:8:1010013005:1.source_cn: 哇哦……穿衣服的仓鼠在说话，你是使魔吧。

say:9:1010013006:1.text:
In that case, this gentleman with the general must be a mage.
I gotta say picking a hamster as your familiar is rather... unique.
say:9:1010013006:1.source_cn: 这么说，将军身边这位<male>先生</male><f...
say:9:1010013006:1.male:
In that case, this gentleman with the general must be a mage.
I gotta say picking a hamster as your familiar is rather... unique.
say:9:1010013006:1.female:
In that case, this lady with the general must be a mage.
I gotta say picking a hamster as your familiar is rather... unique.

say:12:1010013007:1.text:
I'd normally overlook your banter, Valen.
But in front of this magister, you'd better watch your words.
say:12:1010013007:1.source_cn: 维伦，换做平时我大概会放任你。\n但是在这位大人面前，...

say:13:1010013008:1.text: It's rare to command such respect from the general.
say:13:1010013008:1.source_cn: 竟能让将军如此敬重，真是罕见。

say:17:1010013011:1.text: Forgive my rudeness earlier. I'll be sure to make it up to you once this fire has been dealt with.
say:17:1010013011:1.source_cn: 刚才是我失礼了，等到扑灭这场麻烦的火，再好好向你道歉吧。
